Due to the rapid growth of our European office in Oosterhout (NB), we are looking for a full time Inside Sales Representative. As an associate member of the European Sales Team at OnLogic you are the main contact for all inbound activity of our customers. You make a qualification of all the incoming leads and you decide how opportunities and customers are handled. You also manage your own accounts in your assigned region(s) and actively reach out to potential new customers in your assigned region. 
In this role, you'll be responsible for: - Serving as the primary contact for all inbound leads and customers. - Proactively supporting account managers with larger accounts. - Generating leads through outbound calls and emails to create your own future accounts. - Providing pre-sales technical consultation to potential and existing customers. - Collaborating with technical, business, and procurement decision-makers to support projects and deliver the best solutions to customers. - Partnering with the marketing team to drive sales and marketing efforts. 
The team you will be joining: 
Our Sales & Marketing team is a collaborative crew of digital marketers, creative storytellers, revenue drivers, and account strategists dedicated to positioning OnLogic as the first choice in edge computing and helping customers make the impossible possible. Together, they build demand, fuel growth, and champion the customer experience across every touchpoint. From creative campaign development and ecommerce management to strategic account growth, complex solution selling, and partner co-sell motions, this team bridges brand awareness with high-impact revenue generation and scalable sales operations. 
Learn more about Life at OnLogic . 
Requirements - You thrive when working in a multicultural team - Your heart beats faster from the latest technology - You are fluent in English & German or Dutch - Sales experience is preferred but not required for this role

You assess drawings and specifications for manufacturability, monitor progress and ensure that all parties involved have the correct technical information in a timely manner.

You will work simultaneously on various NPI projects, revisions and technical customer questions. Some questions require a quick assessment; Other projects you supervise for several months. You constantly determine what has priority and what action is needed to take a project further. 
You don't wait for information to come to you. When specifications are unclear or progress stagnates, you contact the customer or other stakeholders yourself to achieve clarity and decision-making. 
Occasionally, you will visit a customer or international production location together with an account or program manager. Within the international team, we regularly work together in English. -

Are you a hands-on worker who enjoys working in a logistics environment? For our client, an international market leader in food processing solutions, we are looking for a Warehouse Operator for the Manufacturing Warehouse. In this role, you ensure that goods are delivered on time and to the correct location, so the production process continues to run smoothly at all times. Wie zoeken we? What you bring to the team: A completed lower secondary education (VMBO level or equivalent) A minimum of one year of experience working in a warehouse or logistics setting A good command of English — Dutch language skills are a welcome bonus A valid forklift- and reachtruck certificate Wat bieden wij je? What’s in it for you? A competitive monthly salary between €3,210.30 and €3,741.00 gross, based on a 40-hour work week A full-time position in day shifts (07:30 – 16:00), giving you your evenings free A 12-month contract with the possibility of extension based on performance The opportunity to work in an international, fast-paced, and collaborative team A position within a forward-thinking organization that’s driving innovation and sustainability in the global food industry Functieomschrijving Your role as a Warehouse Operator As a Warehouse Operator, you are the driving force behind smooth and efficient warehouse logistics. Every day, you make sure that all incoming and outgoing goods are handled accurately, safely, and on time. From receiving and inspecting materials to delivering them to the right production lines, your precision keeps operations running flawlessly. You’ll also take part in inventory control, prepare shipments, and actively look for ways to make our processes smarter and more efficient. In short: you are the backbone of the warehouse, ensuring that every product and component ends up exactly where it needs to be. Your main responsibilities: Accepting and verifying deliveries, including accompanying documentation Organising and storing materials in the correct

warehouse locations Picking and staging goods for production according to schedule Conducting stock counts and reporting any irregularities Packing, unpacking, and preparing goods for shipment Operating forklifts and reach trucks safely (a valid certificate is required — or can be obtained via SD Worx Jobs) Taking part in continuous improvement initiatives within the warehouse
